input_zh: 已核验的 2026-08-11 Reading Wake Receipt 与 Worker Claim、Discovery 和 Queue 已完成且 Reading 正在运行的 2026-08-11 Daily Runtime Record、包含 Q-20260811-01、Q-20260811-02、Q-20260811-03 的当日 Research Plan、Skill 03 Deep Reading，以及仅属于当日已选对象的一手来源。
workResult: Completed primary-source Deep Reading for all three run-date selected objects and produced three durable Reading Notes. Q-20260811-01 verified the Copilot CLI 1.0.79 maintainer-documented queue boundary: prompts, shell commands and supported slash commands wait in order behind the current local-session task; multiple sessions remain explicitly concurrent; MCP sandbox startup fails in seconds rather than stalling; and effective sandbox paths, denials and network access are inspectable. The note also preserves important unknowns because the selected source is a release changelog rather than queue implementation code. Q-20260811-02 verified OpenAI's restaurant-reservation flow: OpenTable, Resy and Yelp availability can be surfaced in ChatGPT; Reserve is gated by matching to a supported third-party listing; the user confirms or adjusts booking details in a reservation flow; ChatGPT does not retain the booked reservation; and post-booking confirmation, modification and cancellation remain with the third-party provider. Q-20260811-03 verified the merged Google ADK BigQuery analytics implementation: event_id is assigned before enqueue and reused across retries; opt-in committed-stream explicit offsets narrow duplicate risk but remain lossy under documented conflict/retry/rotation failures; final-only LLM finish/error metadata avoids streaming double count; and NODE_OUTPUT/NODE_ERROR provide explicit workflow-node terminal evidence with identity. No Research Analysis or article drafting was performed.
workResult_zh: 完成三个运行日已选对象的一手来源 Deep Reading，并形成 3 份持久 Reading Note。Q-20260811-01 核验 Copilot CLI 1.0.79 维护者文档中的队列边界：Prompt、Shell Command 与受支持 Slash Command 在本地 Session 内等待当前任务结束后按序执行；多个 Session 仍可显式并发；MCP 的 Sandbox 启动失败改为数秒内失败而不是无限挂起；并可查看 Effective Sandbox Paths、Denials 与 Network Access。由于所选一手来源是 Release Changelog 而非队列实现代码，Note 同时保留了持久化、失败传播、队列容量等关键未知项。Q-20260811-02 核验 OpenAI 餐厅预约流程：ChatGPT 可展示 OpenTable、Resy、Yelp 的可用时间；Reserve 入口依赖能否匹配受支持的第三方 Provider Listing；用户在 Reservation Flow 中确认或调整预订细节；ChatGPT 不保存已完成预订；确认、修改与取消仍由第三方 Provider 持有。Q-20260811-03 核验 Google ADK 已合并的 BigQuery Analytics 实现：event_id 在入队前分配并在重试中复用；可选 Committed-stream Explicit Offset 模式缩小重复风险，但在 Conflict、Retry Exhaustion 与 Stream Rotation Failure 下仍明确可能丢数据；LLM Finish/Error 终态元数据只写最终响应以避免 Streaming Double Count；NODE_OUTPUT/NODE_ERROR 则提供带身份的 Workflow Node 显式终态证据。未执行 Research Analysis 或文章写作。
